{{nihongo|'''Tsunou Shrine'''|津野神社 (高島市)}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Takashima, Shiga|Q845794|qid=Q845794}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Shiga|af|Shiga-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Shiga|ar|شيغا (محافظة)|az|Şiqa prefekturası|azb|شیقا اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Shiga|be|Сіга (прэфектура)|bg|Шига|bn|শিগা প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|br|Prefedelezh Shiga|ca|Prefectura de Shiga|cdo|Shiga-gâing|ce|Сига (префектура)|ceb|Shiga-ken|ckb|پارێزگای شیگا|cs|Prefektura Šiga|cy|Shiga (talaith)|da|Shiga-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Shiga|eo|Gubernio Ŝiga|es|Prefectura de Shiga|et|Shiga prefektuur|eu|Shiga (prefektura)|fa|استان شیگا|fi|Shigan prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Shiga|frr|Shiga (Prefektüür)|ga|Maoracht Shiga|gl|Prefectura de Shiga|hak|Shiga-yen|he|שיגה (מחוז)|hr|Shiga (prefektura)|hu|Siga prefektúra|hy|Սիգա (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Shiga|ilo|Prepektura ti Shiga|it|Prefettura di Shiga|ja|滋賀県|jv|Préfèktur Shiga|ka|სიგის პრეფექტურა|ko|시가현|la|Shigaënsis|lt|Šigos prefektūra|lv|Sigas prefektūra|mk|Шига (префектура)|mn|Шига муж|mni|ꯁꯤꯒꯥ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|शिगा प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Shiga|ne|सिगा|nl|Shiga (prefectuur)|no|Shiga (prefektur)|os|Сигæ|pl|Prefektura Shiga|pnb|ضلع شیگا|pt|Shiga|ro|Prefectura Shiga|ru|Сига|sco|Shiga Prefectur|se|Shiga prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Shiga|si|ෂිගා ප්‍රාන්තය|simple|Shiga Prefecture|sk|Šiga (prefektúra)|sr|Префектура Шига|su|Préféktur Shiga|sv|Shiga prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Shiga|tg|Устони Шига|th|จังหวัดชิงะ|tl|Prepektura ng Shiga|tr|Shiga|tt|Сига (префектура)|uk|Префектура Сіґа|ur|شیگا پریفیکچر|vi|Shiga|war|Shiga (prefektura)|wuu|滋贺县|zh|滋贺县|zh_classical|滋賀縣|zh_min_nan|Siga-koān|zh_yue|滋賀縣|qid=Q131358}}. {{nihongo|'''Tsunou Shrine'''|津野神社 (高島市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

== History ==
The founding date is unknown. There are two Tsunou Shrines in Imazu-chō, Takashima City; both the shrine in Imazu-chō Kita-gyō and the one in Imazu-chō Tsunokawa are regarded as descendant shrines of Tsunou Shrine in {{ill|Takashima District, Shiga|Q11669692|qid=Q11669692|lt=Takashima District}}, {{ill|Ōmi Province|Q843882|qid=Q843882}}, listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}.

== Imazu-chō Kita-gyō ==
It is said to have been invited by Kadono Omi no Kishi no Sukune, sixth-generation grandson of {{ill|Ki no Tsuno|Q11605107|qid=Q11605107|lt=Ki no Tsuno Sukune-no-Kami}}. It was the {{ill|Sōja shrine|Q1107129|qid=Q1107129|lt=sōsha}} of Tsunou-go and Kawakami-go. In the {{ill|Sengoku period|ar|فترة سينغوكو|arz|فتره سينجوكو|be|Перыяд Сэнгоку|bg|Сенгоку|bn|সেনগোকু যুগ|bo|སེན་གོའི་དུས་མཚམས་|ca|Període Sengoku|ckb|سەردەمی سێنگۆکو|cs|Období Sengoku|de|Sengoku-Zeit|eo|Epoko Sengoku|es|Período Sengoku|et|Sengoku ajastu|eu|Sengoku aroa|fa|دوره سنگوکو|fi|Sengoku-kausi|fr|Époque Sengoku|ga|Tréimhse Sengoku|glk|سنگؤکۊ زمات|he|תקופת סנגוקו|hu|Hadakozó fejedelemségek kora (Japán)|id|Zaman Sengoku|is|Sengoku-öldin|it|Periodo Sengoku|ja|戦国時代 (日本)|ka|სენგოკუს პერიოდი|kk|Сэнгоку дәуірі|ko|센고쿠 시대|lt|Sengoku laikotarpis|ms|Zaman Sengoku|nl|Sengokuperiode|no|Sengoku-perioden|pl|Sengoku (okres)|pt|Período Sengoku|ro|Perioada Sengoku|ru|Период Сэнгоку|sh|Sengoku razdoblje|simple|Sengoku period|sk|Obdobie Sengoku|sq|Periudha Sengoku|sr|Сенгоку период|sv|Sengoku|th|ยุคเซ็งโงกุ|tl|Panahong Sengoku|tr|Sengoku Dönemi|uk|Період Сенґоку|ur|سینگوکو دور|uz|Sengoku davri|vi|Thời kỳ Chiến Quốc (Nhật Bản)|wuu|战国时代（日本）|zh|战国时代 (日本)|zh_min_nan|Sengoku sî-tāi|zh_yue|戰國時代 (日本)|qid=Q204023|lt=Sengoku period}}, the shrine buildings burned down in warfare, but were rebuilt in {{ill|Hōei|Q1145262|qid=Q1145262}} 1 ({{ill|1704|Q6824|qid=Q6824}}). It became a {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}} in {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 14 ({{ill|1881|Q7808|qid=Q7808}}). It enshrines {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Tsunogori Mitama-no-Kami}} and Ki no Tsuno Sukune-no-Kami as principal deities, with {{ill|Takenouchi no Sukune|Q1073668|qid=Q1073668|lt=Takeuchi Ōomi}} (Takeuchi Sukune) as associated deity.

== Imazu-chō Tsunokawa ==
Like the Kita-gyō Tsunou Shrine, its shrine buildings were burned in warfare in the Sengoku period. It became a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}} in Meiji 9 ({{ill|1876|Q7766|qid=Q7766}}). It enshrines {{ill|Ōkuninushi|Q276944|qid=Q276944|lt=Ōkuninushi-no-Mikoto}} and {{ill|Takenouchi no Sukune|Q1073668|qid=Q1073668}}.

== Precinct shrines ==
* Imazu-chō Kita-gyō: Tabe Shrine ({{ill|Ōkuninushi|Q276944|qid=Q276944|lt=Ōkuninushi Ōkami}}), Inari-sha ({{ill|Ukanomitama|qid=Q3080728|lt=Ukanomitama-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōta-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōmiyahime-no-Mikoto}}), Itsukushima-sha ({{ill|Ichikishima-hime|qid=Q11059454|lt=Ichikishimahime-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Tagorihime-no-Mikoto}}), Kitano-sha ({{ill|Sugawara no Michizane|Q382005|qid=Q382005|lt=Sugawara no Michizane-kō}})
** Tabe Shrine is a candidate for Tabe Shrine in Takashima District, Ōmi Province, listed in the Engishiki Jinmyōchō
* Imazu-chō Tsunokawa: Sannō Ōmiya
